item.title: Several same-sex couples tie the knot at SF City Hall ahead of Valentine's Day
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO (KRON) -- Love was in the air Friday at San Francisco City Hall as several couples married to celebrate the 22-year anniversary of the Winter of Love.
